ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is on the line segment $AD$, and point B is the midpoint of $CD$, with $AD=9\,cm$, $BC=2\,cm$. What is the length of $AC$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $B$ is the midpoint of $CD$, and $BC=2\,cm$, \\
it follows that $CD=2BC=4\,cm$, \\
Given $AD=9\,cm$, \\
thus $AC=AD-CD=\boxed{5}\,cm$.
